_about: Public-domain Marcus Dods (1834-1909, Free Church of Scotland, professor of New Testament exegesis at New College, Edinburgh) for the Word Hoard: his Expositor's Bible volumes (Genesis; First Corinthians; John, 2 vols) and How to Become Like Christ, clean from CCEL, with three Internet Archive volumes (Mohammed, Buddha and Christ 1878; Israel's Iron Age 1874; The Bible, Its Origin and Nature 1905). Added 2026-10-09 by lane A, round 14 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

dods-genesis: The Expositor's Bible: The Book of Genesis (CCEL print source: New York, A. C. Armstrong, no year; CCEL catalogues 1888)
dods-1-corinthians: The Expositor's Bible: The First Epistle to the Corinthians (CCEL print source: Hodder and Stoughton, 1900)
dods-john-1: The Expositor's Bible: The Gospel of St. John, vol. 1 (CCEL print source: Armstrong, 1891)
dods-john-2: The Expositor's Bible: The Gospel of St. John, vol. 2 (CCEL print source: Hodder and Stoughton, 1892)
dods-like-christ: How to Become Like Christ (CCEL records no print source; catalogued 1897)

dods-mohammed-buddha-christ-1878: Mohammed, Buddha, and Christ: Four Lectures on Natural and Revealed Religion, second edition (London: Hodder and Stoughton, MDCCCLXXVIII)
dods-bible-origin-1905: The Bible, Its Origin and Nature (1905)
